pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Requires the Curios mod.$()$(br2)With it installed, mages can wear trinkets too. Open the "Trinkets" button in the top-left of the mage panel to reach the slots: necklaces, rings, belts and Iron's spell books all go here.
This mod's warehouse terminal fits a hands or bracelet slot, where a hotkey o$(br2)pens the warehouse panel — that hotkey has no default bind, so you have to set one in your controls.
